milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Gray wool is on the left wall at spawn-relative (-1, 1, 4). With max_distance=5, the player must physically approach the wool (be within z=0 to z=8 along the corridor) AND face toward it (within 45°). This prevents triggering from spawn without looking at it. The 5-block radius ensures no overlap with the next milestone (nether_brick_fence at z=10, which is 6.4 blocks away).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Nether brick fence is on the right wall at spawn-relative (3, 1, 10). With max_distance=5, the player must walk forward past the gray wool area and approach the fence section (be within z=6 to z=14) AND face toward it. The target is on the right wall (x=3) while gray_wool was on the left wall (x=-1), so facing vectors differ significantly, adding protection against false triggers.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Yellow terracotta is on the floor and lower walls at spawn-relative (1, 1, 17). With max_distance=5, the player must navigate past the nether brick fence section and approach the terracotta area (be within z=13 to z=22) AND face toward it. The 7-block gap from nether_brick_fence (z=10) ensures no overlap.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Daylight detectors are at the end of the corridor at spawn-relative (1, 1, 25) on raised stone bricks. With max_distance=5, the player must traverse the entire corridor past all previous targets and approach the end section (be within z=21 to z=28) AND face toward the detectors. The 8-block gap from yellow_terracotta (z=17) ensures no overlap.
